label: Enable downmix
help: Uses the FFmpeg downmix path. Requires Prefer app decoders (FFmpeg). When disabled, audio follows the previous Android/device path.

label: Force AC-3 Transcoding (Optical/SPDIF)
help: Transcodes multichannel formats (TrueHD, DTS, AAC, etc.) to Dolby Digital 5.1 in real-time for Optical/SPDIF connections.

label: Maintain original audio on downmix
help: When disabled, downmix normalization can reduce overall volume.

label: Remember audio delay per device
help: Save and restore the in-player audio delay for the current audio output route

label: Skip Silence
help: Skip silent portions of audio during playback

label: Allow Larger Target Buffer
help: Removes the device-memory cap on the Target Buffer Size slider, allowing values up to 2GB. May crash on devices with less than 2GB of RAM.

label: Back Buffer Duration
help: How much already-played content to keep in memory. Enables fast backward seeking without re-downloading. Set to 0 to disable and save memory.

label: Buffer After Rebuffer
help: How much content to buffer after playback stalls due to buffering. Higher values reduce repeated buffering interruptions.

label: Connection Count
help: Number of parallel TCP connections. Higher values increase memory usage and throughput but with diminishing returns.

label: Custom Network
help: Use multiple parallel connections to fetch progressive streams. When off, a single connection is used.

label: Custom Playback Buffers
help: Override Media3's default buffering with the values below. When off, the player uses Media3's stock buffer durations and target size.

label: Initial Buffer
help: How much content must be buffered before playback starts. Lower values start faster but may cause initial stuttering on slow connections.

label: Managed Memory Budget
help: Caps the buffer to a safe share of this device's memory. Turn off to set the Target Buffer Size yourself (advanced — large values can crash low-memory devices).

label: Max Buffer Duration
help: Maximum amount of media to buffer. Must be at least the minimum buffer duration. Higher values use more memory but provide smoother playback on unstable connections.

label: Min Buffer Duration
help: Minimum amount of media to buffer. The player will try to ensure at least this much content is always buffered ahead of the current playback position.

label: Parallel Connections
help: Use multiple connections in parallel for fetching streams. Activate when you experience buffering although your download speed is definitely more than sufficient.

label: Target Buffer Size
help: Maximum RAM used for ahead-buffering. The maximum is calculated from your device's available memory (Android's per-app heap limit), so higher-RAM devices unlock larger caps automatically.

label: VOD Disk Cache
help: Persist downloaded bytes to disk for the current stream. Extends instant seek-back beyond the in-memory back buffer and survives brief network drops. Only applies to progressive streams (no HLS/DASH).

label: Always Backdrop with Logo for Landscape Posters
help: Ignore landscape poster from addon and use backdrop with clearlogo overlay instead.

label: App Focus Scrolling
help: Use Petalix's custom global focus scroll animation and positioning.

label: Blur Unwatched in Continue Watching
